prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: Speck SeeThru Blue Hard Shell Case For 13' MacBook - MB13BLUSEEV2; description: Speck SeeThru Blue Hard Shell Case For 13' MacBook - MB13BLUSEEV2/ Translucent Hard Plastic Shell Gives Great Protection/ Full Access To All Controls/ Rubber Feet For Added Support/ Blue Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Speck Products SeeThru Case for Apple 13' MacBook - MB13-AQU-SEE-V2; brand: Speck Products; description: Plastic - Aqua
2. name: Speck Products SeeThru Case for Apple 13' MacBook - MB13-CLR-SEE-V2; brand: Speck Products; description: Plastic - Clear
3. name: Speck Products SeeThru Case for Apple 13' MacBook - MB13-GRN-SEE-V2; brand: Speck Products; description: Plastic - Green

response.text: {"choice": "none", "confidence": 1.0, "reason": "The model number and brand do not match any candidate exactly."}
